sentences.en: Alienation is the only thing I understand about Marxism.
sentences.zh: 疏远是我在马克思主义中唯一能理解的概念。

sentences.en: Alienation is a common theme of twentieth-century literature.
sentences.zh: 疏远是二十世纪文学中的一个常见主题。

sentences.en: The workers feel a deep alienation from their jobs.
sentences.zh: 工人对工作感到深深的疏远感。

senses.zh: 离间,疏远,（觉得周围环境与自己格格不入的）疏离感,离心离德
